rows.surface: Global JSON serialization including local state and unrelated SDKs
rows.mechanism: No global NSJSONSerialization hook: local persistence and SDK JSON serialization remain native. Mutation occurs only in request dispatch with a known Reddit-domain destination.

evidence.detail: The global serialization hook was removed. Destination-aware dispatch is the mutation boundary, after the final request URL is available.

rows.verification: Native actual-function regression: third-party and lookalike-domain JSON/binary bodies remain byte-identical; Reddit bodies still apply existing fields and preserve opaque session trees. Device critical-path acceptance pending.
rows.fix: Global serialization mutation removed in final integration. Current iOS field schema and signed-request constraints remain separately tracked by WIRE-005/006/010.

rows.surface: HTTP body and upload destination scope
rows.mechanism: A shared request-domain policy gates data bodies and upload data/files; body assignment itself remains native until dispatch. Non-Reddit domains pass through.

evidence.detail: HTTPBody and upload data/files all use RBXIsRedditAPIHost at dispatch. Foreign-domain bodies pass through byte-for-byte.

rows.verification: Native Foundation regression compiles shipped rewrite functions; non-Reddit JSON/protobuf and suffix lookalikes remain unchanged; Reddit JSON/protobuf mutate and nested server-owned trees remain unchanged.
rows.fix: Host boundary closed in code. This is domain-aware, not a proven per-endpoint schema; actual schema/capture work remains WIRE-010.

rows.surface: Request authentication and HMAC after mutation
rows.mechanism: Recognized HMAC, Signature/Signature-Input and Digest/Content-Digest headers freeze the complete request at dispatch. All NSMutableURLRequest assignment stays native, preserving fields when URL or signature is added last. Upload data/files share the guard.

evidence.detail: Recognized signature/digest headers short-circuit the complete request and upload body. There is no signature stripping or claimed re-signing.

rows.verification: Native regression failed on signature/header removal before fix; six case-insensitive signature/digest families now retain original JSON bytes and every header even when identity fields would otherwise change. Device signing order, query signatures and unknown custom authentication remain unverified. Builder-boundary regression rejects assignment hooks; native fixtures cover set/add/all-header builders with signature last and a final URL reassigned to a foreign host. This does not prove later delegate/session-configuration signing behavior.
rows.fix: Partially closed: never strip known signatures or mutate their signed bytes; no re-sign path is claimed. Unsupported signature formats, redirected/resumed requests and captured native critical flows remain an on-device acceptance item.

rows.mechanism: Same-length real-ID byte swaps and printable 96-byte key lookahead; no field-number/schema decoder.

evidence.detail: Length preservation does not establish semantic ownership. A printable value after a key can be unrelated, compressed/encrypted content can evade detection.

rows.verification: Domain guard passes native JSON and binary same/different-host regressions. Source algorithm reviewed; no iOS protobuf schema or captured request corpus establishes safe rewriting.

Replace heuristic with schema-specific transformation, or explicitly configurable pass-through for unsupported schemas; do not claim covered.

rows.surface: Actual current iOS GraphQL and analytics schema
rows.mechanism: Generic key aliases map install, external, ad, device, timing and locale fields. Android evidence is not used to establish current iOS field ownership.

rows.surface: Install timestamp and UTC offset units
rows.mechanism: Timestamp conversion and UTC offset infer units from magnitude; profile generator staggers timestamps but app-persisted fields can have other schemas.

evidence.detail: Zero UTC offset is ambiguous; heuristic does not establish field units or compare source SDK install timestamps.

rows.verification: Unverified on device: no captured current-iOS field/type/unit corpus. Zero UTC offset is intrinsically ambiguous to magnitude inference; generator presence alone is not wire proof.
rows.fix: Keep this known code gap open; do not guess units or add a broad timestamp hook. Acceptance must attribute each emitted field to its current binary caller, compare seconds versus milliseconds and minutes versus seconds at zero/nonzero offsets and DST boundaries, then add exact-schema fixtures before changing conversion.

rows.surface: Analytics geometry, font and locale representation
rows.mechanism: Generic field-name replacement combines profile values and actual app version/build.

rows.verification: OS hooks are independently inventoried; actual payload coherence not yet measured.
